page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head and page number at the top and the catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: fuo gerens, opes copiasque fuas libenter in ufum ac bonum publicum impendens: adeò de republica follicitus semper, ut cum vim veneni jam sentiret, & de dolo non dubitaret, diffimulaverit tamen, ne autorem ejus Philippum ad [?]im patriæ inferendam irritaret.

Tántùm verò miniftro cuidam fuo fi-diffimo, in morbo officia fibi præftanti, cum fputum cruentum in parietem forte ejiceret, dixit: ταῦτ᾽ ἔςιν χάρις τυραννικῆς φιλίας [?], id eft, hæc funt præmia tyrannicæ amicitiæ. Lampada in bene gerenda republica tradidit Philopœmeni Megalopolitano Arcadi. Hic virtutes ejus heroicas imitatus etiam in fortuna minore, octavo demum anno ab ejusdem morte prætura ornatus, & sæpe deinceps prætor rursum factus, multa aliorum vitio fortunæve viprolapsa restituit, multa fortiter patravit, nec ufquam occafionibus defuit: præcipuè Philippo Macedoni Achaicæ reipublicæ adversario gravi sese objecit: cum Machanida tyranno Lacedæmoniorum, & post eum cum Nabide terra marique bellum gessit. Demum Nabide Ætolorum fraude perempto Lacedæmona civitatem maximam & potentissimam diligentia ac virtute sociati Achæorum adjecit.

page.notes: Show-through and bleed-through from the other side of the leaf at the bottom left (Greek-looking and "Achæ"-like fragments) are not transcribed. The Greek phrase on the line after "dixit:" is only partly legible; the tail is marked [?]. "ad [?]im" is a doubtful word (possibly "vim", with a decorative or damaged letter). Long s has been normalised to s; the printed forms "fuo fi-/diffimo" are kept as printed. The catchword "Eandem" is at the right below the last line.
